t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a deep navy ground with a faint blueprint grid. Small eyebrow and a large light-weight sans headline. On the left, one continuous double-line pipe in pale blue-white hairlines enters from the top edge, bends, and drops vertically through a series of P&ID valve symbols, each tagged with a small mono code. On the right, a three-column hairline table with mono-numbered rows aligned to each joint, for <CONTENT>. Footer with a wordmark and a mono page counter. Flat, square corners, no shadows.
signature_idea: A single pipe drops down the page and each of its joints lines up with one row of the log, so the table reads as the pipe's own record.

very calm navy blueprint with hairline art
